method: Two isolated fresh Blender processes. Fixed rigid knife meshes have no modifiers, constraints or shape keys. Their world vertices/normals are reconstructed using the actual evaluated non-culled utensil parent, native parent inverse and local basis; this is explicitly not a claim that viewport-culled evaluated_get returned actual geometry. Reconstruction is cross-checked against actual evaluated visible knife geometry on all work poses. No visibility/controller/project/render mutation. Temporary binary comparison arrays are deleted after comparison.
